scope: Actual JavaScript function execution with synthetic read-only construction snapshots, source preservation and source-derived compact geometry only.
checks: Only one actively building site appears, with stable number, name and observed progress; other work and finished history stay untouched
Completion advances to the next active site and the same site keeps its original number
Screenshot case with only completed sites clears the summary and releases its entire layout space
Active priority is building/module upgrade, power wait, truck wait, travel, then queued; cancelled, failed, interrupted and blocked rows are excluded
Native construction without an app job and module work use the original observed status and display identity
Rendering clamps only visual progress and escapes item names without modifying engine snapshots
Towers installation removes only its redundant Exit button; Duel retains it and footer keep-orders toggles remain byte-identical
Compact CSS has one unclipped text row and progress line, no fixed legacy queue height, and scales with existing text settings
Every unrelated named command/menu/order function remains identical to the v0.46 complete fallback
